description: A small toy kitchen setup is in front, with an open cabinet/fridge compartment and several items on the counter: two bananas, a white egg, a green lime, a red strawberry, and a couple of dark cherries. The left hand holds the cabinet door open while the right hand repeatedly reaches in to place food inside—first sliding one banana onto the bottom, then adding the second banana and the egg; next the right hand lifts the cherries and strawberry onto the middle shelf, then places the lime there too before moving back toward the door.
